items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 我是愚人众执行官第十一席，「公子」达达利亚。而你——哈，也是能招致纷争之人，实在愉快。我们应该会很合得来吧？
items.text_en: I'm No. 11 of the Fatui Harbingers, codename Childe, but I also go by Tartaglia. And you... Hmm, you too like to cause quite the stir, don't you? Something tells me we're going to get along splendidly.

items.title: 闲聊·闲散
items.text: 在这干站着，也不会有对手找上门的。
items.text_en: You know, there are better ways to seek out our enemies than... well, standing here.

items.title: 闲聊·比试
items.text: 嗯——附近就没有什么值得一战的强敌吗？
items.text_en: This place is pretty dead... By which I mean, there's nothing to kill.

items.title: 闲聊·愚人众
items.text: 不知道其他执行官在忙些什么呢？嗯，算了，无非又是那些莫名其妙的「宏大计划」吧。
items.text_en: I wonder what the rest of the Harbingers are up to? Plotting and scheming on an ever-grander scale, no doubt.

items.title: 闲聊·雪国故土
items.text: 在我老家的雪原里这么闲站着的话，早该被冻僵了。哈哈哈。
items.text_en: Where I'm from, if we didn't keep moving, we'd freeze to death. Literally.

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 雨点打在水面上的声音，会把鱼儿吓跑。相比之下，雨后是钓鱼的好时机。
items.text_en: Ah, perfect weather for fishing! The sound of the rain scares them away, but once it stops, they're yours for the taking.

items.title: 下雪的时候·异国
items.text: 哈哈哈，不知老家那边，是否也在下雪？
items.text_en: Haha, ahh... could it be snowing in Snezhnaya too?

items.title: 下雪的时候·至冬国
items.text: 多好的雪！天地都和月光一样干净，在这样的舞台上泼洒的鲜血才格外炙烈。
items.text_en: The world looks glorious in the snow. Pure white, like the light of the moon. A perfect backdrop for bloodshed.

items.title: 起风的时候
items.text: 啊！风中传来了纷争的气息。
items.text_en: The wind is picking up. There is conflict in the air.

items.title: 刮大风了·异国
items.title_en: When the Wind Is Blowing: Foreign Country
items.text: 真是畅快的风！
items.text_en: Just look at that wind blow!

items.title: 刮大风了·至冬国
items.title_en: When the Wind Is Blowing: Snezhnaya
items.text: 感觉身体和头脑，都被穿过身体的风洗净了。真舒畅。
items.text_en: The wind permeates all, cleansing both mind and body. Excellent.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 哟，伙伴！今天精神不错啊。
items.text_en: Morning, comrade! You're raring to go today, I see.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 你看起来状态还不错嘛，要不陪我切磋一下？
items.text_en: You look well. What's your secret? Care to exchange notes?

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 哈——吃得真爽。活动活动，消化一下好了。
items.text_en: Whew, dinner was quite the feast. A spot of exercise is in order.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 真是愉快的一天。明天再见，伙伴！
items.text_en: Today was great. See you tomorrow, comrade!

items.title: 关于达达利亚自己
items.text: 身为战士，要时刻把挑战之心系于刀尖之上。但无论胜败，都是无可替代的珍贵经历。
items.text_en: A warrior must always be ready to face any challenge with his blade. The outcome of the battle is irrelevant — what matters is that you learn from the experience.

items.title: 关于我们·同僚
items.text: 与你同行的事情，在别的执行官当中，已经传开了吧。哼，真想看看那帮人脸上的表情，哈哈哈。
items.text_en: Ah, I'm sure the Harbingers must know of my dealings with you by now. Oh, I'd love to see the look on their faces... Hahaha...

items.title: 关于我们·兵器
items.text: 弓，其实是我最不擅长的武器。正因如此，我才要征服它。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6I am the least adept with a bow. And that is precisely why I must master it.

items.title: 关于我们·生存
items.text: 连神之眼也没有的你，竟有这样的力量，真是令人期待啊…在你抵达自己的极限之前，与我放下一切、决一死战之前，绝对不要倒下啊，伙伴！我绝不允许你倒下。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6You wield such powers without owning a Vision... I really am excited to see what you have in store for us... Let's see how far you can go. Just don't go dying on me before you lay it all on the line in our final battle! I won't allow it!

items.title: 关于我们·邀请
items.text: 伙伴，要不要加入愚人众？嗯，当我没说。以你现在的身份，和你在一起，连光明正大和其他执行官厮杀的理由也有了。这样的机会，实在无法放弃啊，哈。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Comrade, how would you like to join the Fatui? ...Actually, scrap that. With your capabilities, you and I could head-to-head with the Harbingers and win. Wouldn't want to miss an opportunity like that.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 只要能让我变强，「神之眼」也好，「邪眼」也好，师承深渊的罪人也好，都无所谓…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4If it makes me stronger, I'll take it. Vision? Great. Delusion? Don't mind if I do. Heretical teachings from the Abyss? Sign me up.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 在无尽的雪原里，生命随时都会被碎骨一般的纯白天地吞噬，连足迹也无法留下。为此，我们每日都在与看不见的敌人战斗。
items.text_en: The skeletal-white snowscape devours life without leaving any trace. It is the invisible enemy we fight against each day.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 我曾经在世界的深渊与无名的巨大魔兽对视。总有一天，我会堂堂正正地，将那强大得令我骨髓冻结的怪物斩杀。届时，就拜托你当我的见证者了，伙伴！
items.text_en: I once ventured deep into the abyss and came face-to-face with an enormous beast. I don't know its name, all I know is the sight of it chilled me to the bone. But mark my words, one day I will march back in there and behead that beast, and you, comrade, will be my witness!

items.title: 关于丝柯克
items.text: 有多少年没见到师父了呢。哼，下次和她比试的时候，希望至少能逼她用上双手来对付我。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4It's been years since I last saw my master. I should hope that next we meet, I'll at least be able to force her to use both hands to beat me...

items.title: 关于钟离·掂量
items.text: 那家伙城府很深，不知真正的实力又如何呢…哼，真令人期待。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4There's far more to that man than meets the eye. As for the extent of his power... lots to look forward to, I think.

items.title: 关于钟离·挑战
items.text: 钟离先生，最近可好啊？嗯…还不错？看来他倒是挺适应作为「凡人」的生活嘛。可恶…竟然把我骗得团团转，只有痛痛快快地交战一场才能平息这份不甘！你说…我打不过他？哈哈哈…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A New Star Approaches"Tell me, how has Mr. Zhongli been lately? Not bad, you say? Seems he's had no problem acclimating to "mortal" life. Hmph, he sure had me fooled. Such a fiasco mustn't be so easily forgiven! The only way to reconciliation is fierce combat! What do you mean I'm no match for him? Hahaha...

items.title: 关于「女皇」
items.text: 女皇大人其实很温柔。但正是因为太温柔了，所以才不得不变得冷酷。正是因为梦想和平，才要向整个世界宣战。也正是因为她与世界为敌，我才有机会与你相识。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Her Royal Highness the Tsaritsa is actually a gentle soul. Too gentle, in fact, and that's why she had to harden herself. Likewise, she declared war against the whole world only because she dreams of peace. And because she made an enemy of the world, I had the chance to become acquainted with you.

items.title: 关于法尔伽
items.text: 法尔伽吗？哼，光是想到，有朝一日能和西风骑士团的顶点、传说中的「北风骑士」交手，就兴奋得颤抖。活在这个世界上，真是美妙。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Varka? Just the thought of one day going head-to-head with him in combat, the fabled Knight of Boreas himself, titan of the Knights of Favonius... It makes me buzz with excitement. It's a beautiful life we live in this world.

items.title: 想要了解达达利亚·其一
items.text: 记住了，伙伴，我是终有一天要征服世界的人！
items.text_en: Remember, comrade, one day I will conquer the world!

items.title: 想要了解达达利亚·其二
items.text: 无论决斗的对手是神，还是深渊的魔兽，只要有形，就有得胜的可能。但执行官当中，有的人热衷于权术、阴谋那些…「看不见的手段」。我跟那些无聊的家伙合不来。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Face me in person, man to man, and I'll always have a chance of beating you. Same goes if you're a deity or a monster from the abyss. But the Harbingers? They are more enamored with their intangible methods, spending their days scheming and maneuvering. This is why we cannot get along.

items.title: 想要了解达达利亚·其三
items.text: 这里的天空和故乡的天空是连成一片的。抬头看见雪一样的月光，就能想到，老家的人们也能看见同一个月亮。不知道弟弟妹妹…哈，他们有没有变成出色的战士呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4However far away my motherland may be, we all live under the same sky. That snow-white moon... My family must be able to see it too. I hope my siblings are well... And I hope that they have turned out to be formidable warriors too.

items.title: 想要了解达达利亚·其四
items.text: 伙伴，不要忘记：厮杀的时候，绝不能用什么「燃烧起来了」之类的蠢话来驱策自己。毕竟，燃尽之后，除了灰烬，什么也不会剩下。无论如何，都要活下去。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Comrade, a word of advice: Don't go yelling stupid things in the heat of battle. They might sound good in your head, but if you think about it, they make no sense at all. I'm talking about things like, "I'm on fire!" That's the last thing we want. Fire leaves behind nothing but ashes. And you must survive at all costs.

items.title: 想要了解达达利亚·其五
items.text: 时间过得真快。总有一天，我要让你亲眼看见我征服世界的样子、我把神的王座踩在脚下的样子。哈哈，在那之前，你可绝对不要倒下啊，伙伴！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Ah, how time flies. One day, you will see how I conquer the world and crush the thrones of gods beneath my heel. In the meantime... no dying, comrade! Keep yourself alive! Hahaha.

items.title: 达达利亚的爱好
items.text: 冰钓和决斗的道理是相通的，关键是耐心与决断。这么说来，同样的道理好像也能应用在人生中的所有事情上？
items.text_en: Ice fishing and combat follow the same principle. Patience and decisiveness are key. Though having said that... I suppose the same is true of everything in life.

items.title: 达达利亚的烦恼
items.text: 嗯？烦恼的事情…哼，与你同行，总是有值得挑战的强敌，根本没空思考这种琐碎无趣的小事。
items.text_en: My pet peeves? Hmm, well, to be honest, I'm far too busy journeying with you and slaying powerful enemies to dwell on such trifling matters.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 这个世界上，充满了美妙的料理和酣畅淋漓的战斗。活着真是美妙！
items.text_en: There's plenty of delicious food to sink your teeth into in this world... and plenty of fights to sink your teeth into as well. Life is beautiful.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 食物和武器是一样的。真正的战士不会挑剔兵器，也不会挑剔食物。你也不要挑食啊。
items.text_en: Food is like weaponry. A true warrior never deliberates unduly over their choice of weapon, nor do they do so over the food they eat. Neither should you.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 哟，伙伴，生日快乐！有什么想痛打一顿的人吗？有的话，就尽管说出来吧！
items.text_en: Happy birthday, comrade! Anyone you need knocked off their perch today? Let me know. I'll happily oblige...

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 喔！好像变强了一些。找谁试试好了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1Hohoho, I feel like I've gotten stronger! Now, who shall I use as my guinea pig...

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 「战士的力量就像一个圆。圆越大，能挑战的人就越多。」欸，这句话是谁说的来着…
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2"A warrior's strength is like a dome. The bigger the dome, the more opponents he can challenge inside it." Hmm, who was it that said this again?

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 真不错！伙伴，多亏了你，我离「征服世界」的目标又近了一步。就连女皇大人，也不曾料想过我这样的成长吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4Bravo, comrade! Thanks to your help, I am one step closer to my goal of conquering the world. I doubt even the Tsaritsa herself ever expected I would make it this far.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 伙伴，你也要好好锻炼自己才行！不然的话，等我到达了世界的顶点，又有谁能与我殊死厮杀呢？哈哈哈。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6Comrade. Make sure you keep training too. Otherwise, who will be left to fight me to the death when the world lies defeated at my feet? Hahaha.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 要上了！
items.text_en: You're mine!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 哈！
items.text_en: Ha!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 势如狂澜！
items.text_en: Tidal wave!

items.title: 元素战技·其四
items.text: 来吧！
items.text_en: Bring it on!

items.title: 元素战技·其五
items.text: 接下来——
items.text_en: Who's next?

items.title: 元素战技·其六
items.text_en: Hah...

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 一箭止水！
items.text_en: Riptide!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 逃得掉吗！
items.text_en: You can run, but you can't hide!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 破绽，稍纵即逝！
items.text_en: Shouldn't let your guard down!

items.title: 元素爆发·其四
items.text: 忍着点，这可是很痛的。
items.text_en: Brace yourself, this is gonna hurt!

items.title: 冲刺开始·其一
items.text: 兵贵神速。
items.text_en: No time to lose.

items.title: 打开风之翼·其一
items.text: 呵，感觉不错。
items.text_en: I could get used to this.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 好！再去寻找更多的宝藏吧！
items.text_en: Alright, now we're talkin'!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 相当不错！
items.text_en: Not bad... Not bad at all!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 真让人摩拳擦掌！
items.text_en: Now I just need to get my hands on the rest!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 哈！有点意思。
items.text_en: Heh, this is getting interesting.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 不赖嘛！
items.text_en: You're pretty good!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 生死边缘而已，我很擅长处理。
items.text_en: Death looms. My time to shine!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 怎能这样…得而复失…
items.text_en: How... I had only just...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 失手了…
items.text_en: Drat!

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 还挺…有两下子…
items.text_en: I'm... quite impressed...

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 嘁！大意了。
items.text_en: Amateur mistake.

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 哈，强敌何在？
items.text_en: Need to end a few enemies?

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 睁大眼睛看着吧！
items.text_en: Keep your eyes wide open!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 真让我好等！
items.text_en: C'mon, don't keep me waiting!

items.title: 关于「丑角」
items.text: 他是愚人众最初的执行官，也是今日执行官们的领袖，只会在大场面出现。至于他的功绩…坦白说，我不关心。我效忠的对象是女皇大人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4He was the first ever Fatui Harbinger, and today he is our leader. He only appears on important occasions. As for his accomplishments... To be honest, I don't really care. I owe my loyalty and devotion to the Tsaritsa, no one else.

items.title: 关于「队长」
items.text: 我曾见过他在战场上的模样，实在是过于强悍了。或许我的席位太靠后了吧，让他没有留意到我。但就算今天被他忽视，明天，我也会让他看到我的实力。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've seen him in battle before, and oh what a sight it was. Perhaps I'm ranked too low for him to notice me right now. Well, he may not recognize my strengths yet, but one day, I'll show him what I'm made of.

items.title: 关于「博士」
items.text: 听说他把不同年龄段的自己切片做成了义体，负责不同的任务。没办法，我的同僚都是些不太正常的人。反过来想想，要是某一天，我遇见了自己的义体…哈，肯定得和对方决出真正能活下去的那一个。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I heard that he took segments of himself at different ages, made prostheses out of them, and assigned different tasks to each one. I know... all my comrades are a little weird. Well, come to think of it, if I met another version of myself... Hah, we'd have to fight then and there to decide which one of us gets to survive.

items.title: 关于「少女」
items.text: 愚人众执行官的席位是按照实力划分的，我不明白那个女孩为什么是「第三席」。有机会的话，我是想和排在我之前的执行官都比试一遍啦，但总有种不太想和她交手的感觉…不管怎么说，你也小心一点。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The Fatui Harbingers are ranked by strength, and I have no idea why that girl is No. 3. I'd test my skills with every Harbinger who ranks above me if I had the chance, but when it comes to her... something just doesn't feel right. Anyway, you should be careful around her.

items.title: 关于「仆人」
items.text: 我不讨厌有自己打算的人。毕竟我加入愚人众，也是为了获得更多争斗的机会。但这个人，我不喜欢。如果背叛能够获得收益，她会毫不留情地向女皇大人挥剑。她的眼里只有疯狂。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Look, I've got nothing against people who have their own agendas - I myself joined the Fatui to get more experience in combat. But I don't like her at all. If she stood to benefit from betraying others, she'd turn against the Tsaritsa in a heartbeat. There isn't a sane bone in her body.

items.title: 关于「公鸡」
items.text: 我不懂什么人情世故。但我知道，他是真心想要帮助我的。他看我的眼神，就像看待家人一样。哦，说到这个，冬妮娅和托克给我回信的时候，时常提到他送去家里的馅饼和礼物。在我暂别冬都期间，他确实按照约定，照顾好了我的家人们。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I don't know what his motivations could be, but he seems genuine about wanting to help me. He treats me just like family. Oh, and speaking of family - Tonia and Teucer are always telling me about the pastries and other gifts he brings them when they write. So while I've been away form Snezhnaya, he's kept his promise to take care of my family.

items.title: 关于「木偶」
items.text: 好像是个埋头研究的人？我想想，那些机械是不是都跟她有关啊。总之，仅有几次的见面中，她一副想杀了我的眼神。可我完全不记得做过什么惹她生气的事。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4She always seems engrossed in her research. Hmm... I wonder if those machines have anything to do with her? Anyway, I've only met her a few times, but every time she looked like she wanted to murder me. I have no idea what I possibly could have done to annoy her, though.

items.title: 关于「富人」
items.text: 哦，那个满脑子「宏大计划」的野心家。他的那些理论，我半句都听不进去啊。总之，只要后备资金管够就好啦。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, now that guy has a head full of grandiose plans fueled by raw ambition. I don't understand a word he says once he starts talking about his theories... Eh, but as long as he keeps our cash reserves stocked up, I'm not complaining.

items.title: 关于「女士」
items.text: 我和她合不来，你是知道的。如今也不必评价她本人了吧。对于执行官而言，死期并不掌握在自己手上…不过，放心，我是无论如何，都会拼尽全力活下去的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"I never got along with her, you know that. I guess there's not much more worth saying about her at this point. When you're a harbinger, you have to accept that death could come at any time... But don't worry about me. No matter what happens, I'll do whatever it takes to keep myself alive.

items.title: 关于「散兵」
items.text: 他带着「神之心」与我们失去了联络，后面才有了追回那颗心的行动。我倒是不介意去四处走走，说不定还能在哪儿和你偶遇？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "Omnipresence Over Mortals"After he took the Gnosis, we lost all contact with him. Now comes the task of trying to hunt it down and get it back... I actually don't mind it - it means I get to travel all over. Wonder if I'll run into you somewhere along the way?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 只要吃到好吃的，心情就会十分舒畅。我该如何回报你呢？
items.text_en: Eating delicious food really has a way of taking all your cares away. Now, how should I repay you?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 你的厨艺似乎长进了不少。难道你也在不断变强吗？
items.text_en: Your cooking skills seems to have improved quite a lot. Does that mean you're getting stronger all the time, too?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 真是出乎意料的口感，好…我就再试一次吧。
items.text_en: Um, I'll admit the taste surprises me a little. Hmm? Okay... I'll try one more bite.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 你们，最近是不是缺乏锻炼啊？
items.text_en: What's the matter, out of practice?

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 闪开！这里让我来！
items.text_en: Step aside, it's my turn!
